template_data.headline_html: Five pricing rules most GSA holders learn the hard way.

items.title: Know your BOA customer
items.sub: Your contract is priced to your best commercial deal — know who that is.

items.title: Price Reduction Clause bites
items.sub: Go below your BOA commercially post-award? Gov may recoup the difference.

items.title: Pricelist must stay current
items.sub: Stale pricelist freezes your ability to quote on any RFQ.

items.title: Negotiate headroom upfront
items.sub: The CO will push rates down — build margin before you submit.

items.title: Every change needs a mod
items.sub: New service, new rate, new discount? Formal modification, no exceptions.
